scope: Development Planner failures on the 16 pre-classified supported cases. Unsupported cases were not executed and are only counted by capability category.

representative_supported_cases.detail: The model catalog does not expose the Development Planner's simplified width aggregate attribute.
The phrase 'Which room ... is the largest?' did not produce an existing aggregate plan.
The planner attempted object resolution for the phrase 'narrowest used here'.

no_remediation: Per frozen held-out protocol, no Planner, Engine, terminology, Drawing Retrieval, or benchmark-ground-truth changes were made after observing these results.
